fact: The Ministry of Digital Transformation and Communications and the National Investment Authority announced the needs-disclosure service live on the Baladna platform, linking the industry, transport and agriculture bodies and passing approved items to the Customs Authority, with data moving between them electronically.
The National Investment Authority's Secretary-General said the electronic single window will operate once all entities related to investment work are linked electronically, with no date given.

The Ministry of Digital Transformation and Telecommunications is said to offer the UNIVERSAL SECURE (CONSOLEX) unified API gateway, which integrates government systems and enables secure data exchange among institutions; no connected-body count or volume is given.

The Sudan government portal says Baladna, a government data and transactions exchange platform, carried the first fully electronic export contract between the Central Bank of Sudan, the Ministry of Trade and Industry, customs, standards, ports, border crossings, tax and Zakat systems.
Sudan's Minister of Digital Transformation and Communications said the ministry has begun implementing institutional tracks to create a unified platform for government data exchange.
